title: Kaa by Snek: Your Friendly AI Companion for Onboarding Masses and Enhancing Community Engagement

ms.promise:
・A website that allows users to upload their project-specific information.
・User authentication flow (e.g using Discord login)
・User interface for file management and interaction.
ms.criteria:
・The website must support user registration, and login.
・Users can upload and manage their project information.
・The website should be compatible with major browsers and mobile-responsive.

ms.promise:
・A data pipeline that processes uploaded information from the project management platform.
・Database setup for storing the embeddings (the project-specific data) for use by AI model.
・Agentic workflow allowing for querying of Cardano on-chain data.
・Integration of the retrieval system with the AI model.
・API that exposes functionality to query the chatbot, allowing authorized systems to interact with the service.
ms.criteria:
Data Pipeline:
1. Embedding Generation:
 - 95% or higher success rate in generating embeddings from uploaded documents
 - Support for 3 different file types (DOCX, TXT, PDF)
 - Ability to process documents up to 5MB in size

2. Storage and Retrieval:
 - 95% uptime for the embedding storage system
 - Retrieval speed of relevant embeddings under 1.5 seconds for 99% of queries
 - Ability to handle concurrent requests (at least 10 simultaneous queries)

3. Performance Benchmarks:
 - Document processing speed: at least 1 page per 1 seconds
 - Embedding generation: at least 50 embeddings per minute
ms.report:
Data Pipeline: 
1- Embedding Generation:
・95% or higher success rate in generating embeddings from uploaded documents (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.4-embedding-generation-stage)
・Support for 3 different file types (DOCX, TXT, PDF) (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.2-document-loading-stage)
・Ability to process documents up to 5MB in size (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.6-performance-scaling)

2- Storage and Retrieval:
・95% uptime for the embedding storage system (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.5-database-operations-stage)
・Retrieval speed of relevant embeddings under 1.5 seconds for 99% of queries (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.5-database-operations-stage)
・Ability to handle concurrent requests (at least 10 simultaneous queries) (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.7-data-pipeline-performance-under-load)

3- Performance Benchmarks:
・Document processing speed: at least 1 page per 1 seconds (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.2-document-loading-stage)
・Embedding generation: at least 50 embeddings per minute (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.4-embedding-generation-stage)
・System maintains performance with up to 500MB of total uploaded data (https://snek-2.gitbook.io/kaa-m2-submission#id-3.3-semantic-chunking-stage)

 Chatbot Service:
